notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation. The revised one opens the T-1 bores by the press clearance per side (Ø3.1 body, Ø4.1 flange seat); the slit width and the nail holes (Ø1.0, an interference the reference intends) keep their size. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
